finding: Reference flood_ida interior-mark regex over-flags (31 vs about 10 true interior marks); depth test should use the reviewed list.
Reference fire_ems ZIP mapping drops ZIP 11249 (94 structural fires in 2025): it is listed in the MODZCTA label but not the zcta field. Fix observed_by_area to also read the label.
Score My Layer's areal path joins by a single code, so it can't aggregate postal ZIPs into multi-ZIP areas (MODZCTA); add a crosswalk option.
'92% within 1 min after removing bias' is in-sample and partly reflects the narrow spread of both series; describe it as descriptive, not predictive (matches the external reviewer's point).
Proof-case toolbox tools have no study-area parameter (FireCoverage runs citywide only); add an area filter.

Open-land distance is built from a perimeter-selected layer, so it partly encodes position inside the burned area; the reversed sign should not be read as 'open land is protective'. Models fitted on one fire don't transfer (AUC about 0.5).
